headlines.title: US and Iran Trade New Strikes as the War Enters its 7th Month
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are exchanging new attacks across the Middle East, following days of renewed threats from both sides. CENTCOM says the U.S. struck Iranian air defense sites, radar systems and other military targets in response to Iran’s recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: USS Lincoln Docks After Nearly 300 Continuous Days at Sea
headlines.description: After more than 280 days at sea and reports of deteriorating conditions and morale, thousands of sailors and Marines from the USS Abraham Lincoln are finally on land. The ship arrived at a port in Eastern Thailand on Wednesday to take a four-day break from its deployment supporting the war in Iran before heading home to San Diego. NBC’s Courtney Kube reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Markey, Neal, and Lynch projected winners in Massachusetts Democratic primaries
headlines.description: NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down numbers in the Democratic primary races in Massachusetts including U.S. Senate and House Districts 8 and 1.

headlines.title: Alaska finalizes Senate race: 3 Republicans, 2 Dan Sullivans and 1 Democrat
headlines.description: Former Rep. Mary Peltola will be the only Democrat on the ballot after Democrat David Leslie, who finished fourth in the primary, withdrew.

headlines.title: Key Texas county votes to cut polling sites ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Officials in Tarrant County, the third most-populous in Texas, approved a plan to reduce the number of polling locations by 92 compared to the 2022 elections.

headlines.title: No plans for ICE to be at polls for midterms, DHS says
headlines.description: A senior DHS official said ICE will do its regular duties on the day of midterm elections, though Secretary Markwayne Mullin said agents would enter a polling place to serve a warrant.

headlines.title: Tiger Woods pleads ‘no contest’ in DUI case
headlines.description: Tiger Woods reached a plea deal with prosecutors Wednesday in connection with DUI charges against him following a crash near his Florida home earlier this year.

headlines.title: What the jury must consider while deciding Lindsay Clancy's fate
headlines.description: As the jury considers the arguments presented by the prosecution and defense in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial, NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris and correspondent Steven Romo break down the instructions the 9 women and 3 men were given before heading into deliberations.

headlines.title: Ariana Grande tearfully ends 41-show tour and steps back from public life
headlines.description: A teary and visibly emotional Ariana Grande bid farewell to her fans as her 41 show tour concluded in London and she began her planned withdrawal from public life.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Richard Engel on Ukraine and more
headlines.description: Richard Engel is back in Ukraine to report on its intensifying war with Russia, with a strike this weekend on a warehouse west of Kyiv becoming its deadliest attack this year — more than 38 people were killed.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
